POST /v1/packages/{packageId}/documents/.name: Fill Initials
request_fields: RC (Required when the initial field has no stored image)

GET /v1/connectors/iss.name: Get List Internal Signing Service Connector (ISS)

POST /v1/csc/credentials/list.name: Get Filtered Credential List
request_fields: RC(When the connector_name have the same name)

POST /v1/csc/packages/{packageId}/docume.name: Sign Document via RSSP Directly
request_fields: RC (When more than one connector shares the same connector name)

POST /v1/csc/credentials/info.name: Get Credentials Info
request_fields: RC(When the connector_name is have the same name in DB)
RC(When signing via RSSP,… except USB-Token)
RC(When signing via USB-Token => Get from USB)

POST /v1/csc/credentials/register.name: Register Certificate via RSSP
request_fields: RC(When the enrollment_connector is have the same name in DB)

GET /v1/enterprise/packages/{packageId}/.name: Get Workflow User Permissions of Enterprise Package

PUT /v1/enterprise/packages/{packageId}/.name: Update Workflow User Permissions of Enterprise Package

GET /v1/enterprise/packages/{packageId}/.name: Get Workflow User Authentication (Document Opening) of Enterprise Package

PUT /v1/enterprise/packages/{packageId}/.name: Update Workflow User Authentication of Enterprise Package
